purpose: Isolated river-bank composition study; these values never configure the game world.

controls.seed: Repeat the small variation within each deliberately positioned plant/stone group.
controls.render.pixels: Review image dimensions; not a runtime resolution setting.
controls.render.samples: Offline noise reduction effort; not runtime cost.
controls.render.world_strength: Ambient sky fill keeps shaded ground and creatures readable.
controls.render.sun_energy: Daylight contrast in the neutral composition review.
controls.render.mist_density: Distance separation; a clear-air comparison is also rendered.
controls.palette: Linear scene colours for earthy hosts, quiet water and narrow cool currents.
controls.current_energy: Strength of the small recessed current, not whole-object glow.
controls.surface: Object-space moss/grain frequency and bump strength/depth; keeps ground detail in metres instead of stretching it over the whole scene.
controls.scar: Dark-edge and luminous half-widths, small surface offsets and intermediate samples to seat the study ribbons against the curved bank. These are not sculpted depth or gameplay radii.
controls.foreground_roots: Visible anchoring roots per near tree.
controls.trees: Authored x/y ground positions, size multipliers and yaw, in Blender coordinates; no gameplay placements.
controls.undergrowth_patches: Centres and spread of connected low plant groups, leaving the river and approach open.
controls.views: Repeatable eye-height and overview comparisons. Eye height is above the study bank surface.
